titulo_es: Identify the question and the main information

texto: Identify main idea, details and attitude in information texts read or heard. **Reportern frågar efter exempel** means «Journalist calls for examples». It relates the expression to the purpose of the text. Look at the connectors and reformulate the idea with your own words before you respond.
